decisions.reason: The enclosed laser marking workstation line extends the firm's core laser competence to manual and small-batch applications, and a large growing firm would not withdraw a multi-model line launched only a year ago.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer fills a standard gap in a single-source coding portfolio, drives recurring consumables revenue, and has its own dedicated web page.

The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal inkjet model for industrial-grade inks and surfaces, fits the strategy of matching technology to each surface, and was only recently launched with dedicated web presence.
